name: Airhead
source:
Airhead is one of the employees at the Ghoul's Grove. She brings a silly and lighthearted attitude, but struggles with reading the room and tends to accidentally get into trouble.

She wears a yellow and dark purple/red dress, with accessories that look like water droplets. She has a gigantic wobbly head that conceals one of her eyes. Her makeup is runny, like she has been recently crying, yet she has an elated expression on at all times.
